direction_note: features are NOT sign-flipped for SHORT trades (semantics preserved)
features_used: all names in CANONICAL_FEATURES, raw values (not direction-adjusted), exact order

groups.mfe_1r: MFE >= 1.0R (R = |entry_fill - sl|; MFE/MAE from highs/lows of bars entry+1..exit-1, plus the exit bar in full for non-stop/non-TP exits, or only the realised exit excursion for STOPPED/TP exits)

oos: chronological split of trades by entry time: first 70% (floor) = train, rest = test; candidates selected on train only: n_with>=2, n_without>=2 and |dNetR|>=0.10

patterns.NP: window's last two runs are (-,+) ('other': single upward crossing); transition bar = start of last run
patterns.NPN: three consecutive runs (-,+,-) anywhere in the window; transition bar = start of 3rd run
patterns.PN: window's last two runs are (+,-) ('other': single downward crossing); transition bar = start of last run
patterns.PNP: three consecutive runs (+,-,+) anywhere in the window; transition bar = start of 3rd run

phases.before: bars [entry-W+1 .. entry] (entry bar close is when the entry is decided; causal)
phases.during: bars [entry+1 .. entry+W], only if the trade is still open through entry+W (descriptive only)

sign_rule.non_signed_feature: sign(x_t - trailing median of previous 96 bars, current excluded); equal -> 0
sign_rule.run_cleanup: consecutive equal signs form a run; runs shorter than min_run_len are removed; adjacent equal runs merged
sign_rule.signed_feature: min<0<max over the post-warm-up corpus (property of the feature, not of outcomes) -> sign(x_t)

tests.baseline: pattern base rate over corpus windows (stride 4); exact binomial test of trade-window frequency against it
tests.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg q over every row with n_with>=2 and n_without>=2; Bonferroni threshold reported
tests.outcome_effect: mean net R with vs without pattern; Hedges g; bootstrap 95% CI (2000); permutation p (5000, seed 42)
tests.prevalence: Fisher exact (group A vs B), risk difference
